channel.title: Six Strings App Blog (EN)
channel.description: Six Strings App articles: rhythm, chords, fretboard, scales, harmony, and ear training.

item.title: Fretboard Explorer: why I built a tool for understanding the fretboard, not memorizing shapes
item.description: A personal story behind the Fretboard Explorer in Six Strings App: why chord shapes are not enough, and how notes, intervals, chords, and scales can help you understand the guitar or bass fretboard.

item.title: Guitar strumming pattern library: how to find the right rhythm for a song faster
item.description: A guitar strumming pattern library with ready-made rhythmic patterns in different time signatures. Helps you preview options quickly, choose the right strumming pattern, and find ideas for practice and songwriting.

item.title: Online metronome for guitar practice: a mini drum machine for daily training
item.description: The Six Strings App online metronome helps you practice with more control and musical feel: customizable sound, progressive tempo mode, practice timer, genre-based patterns, flexible subdivisions, and saved custom rhythms.

item.title: What CAGED Is and How It Helps You See Chords Across the Fretboard
item.description: Learn what the CAGED system is, why it matters for guitarists, and how the Six Strings App tool helps you see chord shapes across the fretboard. Includes the origin story and practical first use cases.

item.title: Circle of Fifths: how to quickly understand relationships between keys
item.description: How to use the circle of fifths in practice: see relationships between keys, understand major and minor, choose chords, and make sense of harmony faster.

item.title: Harmony: how to see key chords, hear cadences, and understand modulations
item.description: An online tool for working with harmony: key chords, chord functions, cadences, and modulations with audio playback right in the browser. Useful for practice, arranging, and songwriting.

item.title: Rhythm Trainer for Guitarists: How to Develop Inner Pulse Through the Rhythmic Alphabet
item.description: What a rhythm trainer is, how it relates to Benny Greb’s rhythmic alphabet, and why it helps guitarists develop inner pulse, timing, and a stronger sense of rhythm.

item.title: Chords, Arpeggios, and Scales for Guitar, Bass, and Ukulele: A Tool for Practice and Improvisation
item.description: An online tool for finding chord fingerings, arpeggios, and suitable scales for guitar, bass, and ukulele. Useful for practice, improvisation, and song analysis. Six Strings App

item.title: Why I Created Six Strings App: From Personal Practice to an Open Project for Musicians
item.description: The story behind Six Strings App: how a personal project for rhythm, fretboard, chords, scales, harmony, and ear training grew into an open platform for musicians.
